WITH CardData AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        c.artist,
        c.setCode,
        c.convertedManaCost,

    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code

),

    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN legal_format_count > 0 
            THEN legal_format_count * (1.0 / (COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 0.1) + 0.1))
            ELSE 0
        END AS viability_index
    FROM CardData
),
MedianCalc AS (
    SELECT 
        subtypes,
        viability_index,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subtypes ORDER BY viability_index) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY subtypes) as total_count
    FROM CardWithVI
    WHERE subtypes != ''
),

    SELECT 
        subtypes,
        AVG(viability_index) as median_vi
    FROM MedianCalc
    WHERE rn IN ((total_count + 1) / 2, (total_count + 2) / 2)
    GROUP BY subtypes
)

    c.name,
    c.artist,
    c.setCode
FROM CardWithVI c
